mechanism_claims.entity_scope: eight lysine- and arginine-based lipopeptides tested in this paper
mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper provides phenotype-level antimicrobial activity against one Gram-positive bacterium, one Gram-negative bacterium, and one fungus; this supports activity evidence but not a direct molecular mechanism assignment.
mechanism_claims.limitations: MIC/MBC/MFC assays are endpoint phenotypes; they do not identify the antimicrobial mechanism of action.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: tested lipopeptides in HaCaT and Strat-M safety/permeation assays
mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper reports cytotoxicity and lack of detectable permeation through the model membrane surface under its assay conditions; this is safety/permeation evidence rather than antimicrobial mechanism evidence.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Permeation and cytotoxicity do not establish target engagement against microbes.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Discussion references membrane-related mechanisms from prior lipopeptide literature, but this paper does not directly test membrane disruption for the antimicrobial endpoints.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Kept as contextual caution; not promoted to direct_mechanism.
